description_en: Retrieves the voice intercom address of an IPC device
description_zh: 调用该接口获取IPC设备的语音对讲地址
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual query-voice-intercom --scheme rtmp --iot-instance-id iot-cn-n6w1y00000 --product-key a1BwAGV0000 --device-name camera1 --iot-id C47T6xwp6ms4bNlkHRWCg40000 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: QueryVoiceIntercom

parameters.description_en:
The connection protocol type for voice intercom. Valid values:

- **ws**: WebSocket connection protocol. The web voice call address obtained by calling this operation when implementing voice intercom on the web. <props="china"><ph>For more information about implementing voice intercom between the web and the device, see [Web voice intercom integration](~~2545966~~).</ph></props>
- **rtmp** (default): The voice call address obtained by calling this operation when implementing voice intercom on Android and iOS application players. For more information about implementing voice intercom between Android and iOS applications and the device, see [Android voice intercom](~~260925~~) and [iOS voice intercom](~~253953~~).
parameters.description_zh:
语音对讲的连接协议类型。可取值：

- **ws**：表示WebSocket连接协议。Web端实现语音对讲能力时，调用本接口获取的Web语音通话地址。<props="china"><ph>Web端与设备端实现语音对讲能力的详细说明，请参见[Web语音对讲集成说明](~~2545966~~)。</ph></props>
- **rtmp**（默认）：Android和iOS应用端播放器实现语音对讲时，调用本接口获取的对应语音通话地址。Android和iOS应用端与设备端实现语音对讲能力的详细说明，请参见[Android语音对讲](~~260925~~)和[iOS语音对讲](~~253953~~)。

parameters.description_en:
The **ProductKey** of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the information of all products under the current account on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console or by calling the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call the [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) operation to query the device ID.

><notice> **IotId** is the unique identifier of the device and has a one-to-one mapping with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**. If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. If you specify **IotId** together with the combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>
parameters.description_zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用接口[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> **IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
